Hiding secret PINs in plain sight on a randomized grid of colored numbers. Shoulder-surfers and security cameras see only noise.
To read your PIN, combine three elements known only to you:
When creating a card, choose a secret color. The app conceals this color in normal view, so an observer cannot tell which color is the real one.
Choose where your sequence begins on the matrix (e.g. top-left corner, center tile, or row 2 column 3).
Follow your geometric path across the matrix (e.g. diagonal down-right, chess knight\'s move, or reverse L-shape).
Tip: Write a clever, subtle Rule Hint that makes sense only to you (e.g., \"Knight from bottom-right\").
How the algorithm baffles onlookers and camera analysis
• Linear Decoy PINs: The app automatically places decoy lines (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) of uniform colors across the matrix. Anyone scanning the screen sees multiple false patterns.
• Strict Non-Adjacency: Decoy tiles matching your secret color are strategically scattered so they never touch your real PIN tiles, eliminating clustering suspicion.
• Color Concealment: The true PIN color is never shown on the card title or matrix view during normal usage.
Biometric timed reveal with instant extinguish

If you ever forget your path or need immediate verification:

1. Tap the "Tap for Biometric Reveal" button.
2. Authenticate with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN.
3. The secret tiles illuminate in their genuine color for a 12-second window with a live countdown timer.
4. Tap the button again at any time to immediately extinguish the reveal and return to decoy camouflage mode.
Organize matrices by type or custom group

• Category & Folder Chips: Use the horizontal filter bar on the main screen to filter by Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Banking, Access Safes, or custom folders.

• Custom Folders: Assign cards to custom folders (e.g. "Personal", "Work", "Travel") in the card editor.

• Deleting Cards: Tap the trash icon in the matrix detail screen or select "Delete Matrix" from the card's 3-dot menu. Deletions always require explicit confirmation.
Switch phones safely with zero cloud dependency

Pin Vault is 100% offline. To transfer your cards to a new phone:

1. Tap the Backup icon (Sync) on the main vault screen.
2. Enter a strong backup passphrase to generate an AES-256-GCM encrypted payload.
3. Share or copy the .pinvault data to your new device.
4. On the new phone, open Pin Vault -> Import Vault, paste the data, and enter your passphrase.

• Screenshot & Recording Blocked: Android FLAG_SECURE prevents rogue apps from taking screenshots or capturing video of your vault.

• App Switcher Shield: Vault contents are hidden in Android Recents (task switcher).

• Zero Network Access: The application requests no internet permission and transmits no telemetry.
Visual steganography PIN & credential vault for Android. Shields sensitive access codes from physical shoulder-surfers and surveillance cameras.
Inspired by an earlier orphaned application \"Pin Keeper\", which stopped working under newer versions of Android. Re-architected from the ground up for modern Android devices.

• 100% Offline: Zero internet permission requested.
• Anti-Snoop: Android FLAG_SECURE prevents screenshots & screen recordings.
• Strong Cryptography: AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2 (100k rounds) for portable backups.
• Biometric Peeker: Android BiometricPrompt hardware integration.
